site.name: Muslim
site.title: Muslim - Quran, Hadith, Azkar & Prayer Times
site.description: Muslim is an open-source Islamic platform for reading and listening to the Quran, exploring authentic Hadith, daily Azkar, prayer times, live radio, and more.

home.title: Muslim - Quran, Hadith, Azkar & Prayer Times
home.description: Read and listen to the Holy Quran, explore authentic Hadith collections, follow daily Azkar, check prayer times, and listen to live Islamic radio - all in one place.

readQuran.title: Read Quran
readQuran.description: Read the Holy Quran by Surah or Juz in the Uthmani script with tafseer, translation, saved ayahs, and audio.

readHadith.title: Read Hadith
readHadith.description: Browse authentic Hadith collections, search by text or number, and save your favourite hadiths.

listenQuran.title: Listen to Quran
listenQuran.description: Listen to the Holy Quran with renowned reciters, ayah-level controls, Hifz repeat mode, and downloads.

radios.title: Live Islamic Radio
radios.description: Listen to 125+ live Islamic radio stations, including Quran, Ruqyah, Fatawa, and translated recitations.

azkar.title: Azkar & Duas
azkar.description: Daily morning and evening Azkar, duas, and tasbeeh counters with progress tracking.

prayerTimes.title: Prayer Times
prayerTimes.description: Accurate prayer times, next-prayer countdown, and Hijri and Gregorian dates for Egyptian governorates.

tasbeeh.title: Tasbeeh Counter
tasbeeh.description: A simple digital tasbeeh counter with goals, keyboard shortcuts, and locally saved progress.

searchAyah.title: Search the Quran
searchAyah.description: Search the Holy Quran by word or phrase and jump straight to any ayah.

generateAyahImage.title: Ayah to Image
